research_questions: What are the most recent technical improvements to Prime and Base editing in 2023-2024?
What is the current regulatory landscape following the first FDA approvals for CRISPR therapies?
What new delivery mechanisms (viral and non-viral) have been developed to target specific organs like the brain or heart?
How is AI/Machine Learning being used to predict off-target effects or design guide RNAs?
What are the latest advancements in in vivo (inside the body) vs ex vivo CRISPR applications?
intent_analysis.success_criteria: A detailed synthesis of technical breakthroughs, clinical trial milestones, and regulatory updates from the last 12-18 months.
missing_information: Specific focus area (e.g., human therapeutics vs. agricultural improvements)
Level of technical depth required (academic/scientific vs. general industry overview)
assumptions: The user is interested in the most recent developments (2023-present).
The focus is primarily on medical and scientific breakthroughs rather than just financial/stock performance of biotech companies.
